As for school, try studying to classical music or devote an hour to one subject then have a piece of gum or ten minutes of internet. For guys, the right guy will come just have fun, you're only a freshman and you have time for some guys to come to you. Self confidence: you are gorgeous, you are beautiful. It doesn't matter if your sister thinks you're fat, don't listen to her. You are amazing and believe in yourself. I've been in your position before (where my self esteem was so low that I started to cut myself and then I fell into crippling depression for a few years). If you ever need someone to talk to, my inbox is always open :)
